title: Your MOS photo
sub: I find your head, check the rules and crop to exactly what MOS asks. Nothing is retouched.
tip: Best: someone else takes it, you face the camera against a plain light wall, in daylight.
progress: Finding your head and checking the rules
noHead: I couldn't find a head in this photo. Use a photo of one person facing the camera.
noSpace: The photo doesn't leave enough space around your head to crop it correctly.
attachFailed: Could not update your case. Try again.
recent: This photo was taken in the last 6 months.
onlyCropped: Only cropped and resized. Upload this file in MOS yourself; Dossierly never files for you.
errFailed: The photo check failed. Try again.
errTooBig: Could not make the photo small enough.
check_lighting: Even light, no shadows on the face
check_glasses: No glare or dark lenses on glasses
noteNoHead: We couldn't find your head in this photo.
noteShoulders: Your shoulders may be in the outline, so we estimated where your chin is. Check the crop.
noteTooBig: Step back a little: your face is too big in this photo for a passport-style crop.
noteTop: Step back a little — there isn't enough space above your head.
noteBottom: Step back a little — we need to see your neck and the top of your shoulders under your chin.
noteSide: Move to the middle of the frame — your head is too close to the side of the photo.
noteLowRes: The photo's resolution is a bit low, so the final picture may look soft. A sharper photo works better.
noteNoChecks: We couldn't run the photo checks just now. Try again in a moment.
noteSecondFace: We may be seeing a second person or face. Make sure it's only you in the photo.
noteFaceNotFound: We couldn't find your head in this photo. Face the camera in good light and keep your whole head in the picture.
noteUnsure: We couldn't judge this one from the photo.
beforeAlt: Your photo as you chose it
